audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Vayne Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and 6 even though the page's own why-strings say Kled's W comes online at 2, his E-W-E combo owns 3, he out-trades a pre-two-item Vayne at 4-5, and 6 is a coinflip.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Vayne/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill/Skill/Vayne and the win rate is an even 50.23% over 438 games — Kled owns the mid-early window, Vayne owns level 1 and two-plus items.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-4 flipped to Kled, Level 6 flipped to Skill, in both layers.

audit.why: Kled spikes levels 2-3 (W four attacks, E re-cast) and on first item; Vayne spikes at level 1 with Silver Bolts percent-max-HP true damage and again at two-plus items where that true damage ignores every point of Skaarl's bonus health. Final Hour is 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: Spike text kept; no fabricated additions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is treated as something to 'track' with no cooldown, and Tumble's auto-attack-reset tell — the actual cue for when her burst starts — is absent everywhere on the page.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s, by far the longest gap in her kit and the whole window Kled needs; it is a projectile and creates the wall-stun only on terrain collision. Tumble is an auto-attack reset (6/5/4/3/2s), so her damage starts on the attack wind-up, not the dash — and under Final Hour Tumble grants invisibility, which is what breaks Kled's E target lock.
audit.corrected: Condemn's 12-20s cooldown and the Tumble reset tell written into the interaction and cooldown fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that her combo opens on an auto-reset.
audit.why: The visible cue is the attack wind-up during Tumble, not the dash itself.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Q-pull so she can’t kite. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Condemn (E), 12-20s: her only escape, and it stuns only if you hit terrain. Bait it, then commit. - Tumble (Q) is a 2-6s auto reset — her burst starts on the attack wind-up. - Your R (140/125/110s): kill windows only, never chip.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Q-pull so she can’t kite. When it is down — Q-pull + W her.
edits.after: Condemn (E) is 12-20s and only stuns on terrain — fight in open ground and bait it, then Q-yank and unload W. Her burst opens on Tumble's auto reset: step back on the wind-up.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Q-pull so she can’t kite. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Condemn is 12-20s and stuns only into terrain. Bait it in open ground, then Q-yank.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Terrain collision is what turns her knockback into a stun — fight away from walls.

edits.before: She kites your dismount — Q-pull to stick, all-in early. Kled wins by trading around Vayne's Condemn and cashing the pattern: q-pull to stick and all-in her early.
edits.after: She kites your dismount — Beartrap to stick, all-in at 2-3. Kled wins by baiting Condemn (12-20s) in open ground, then E in, W's four attacks, re-E out before Silver Bolts stack three.

notes: Chart disagreed with the packet and with the page's own why-strings; flipped as matched pairs. Tumble's auto-reset tell (the one missing interaction for this matchup) is now on the page. Whether Condemn's knockback can be QSS'd or whether tenacity shortens the wall-stun is not in the kit data, so it is not asserted.
